title: Rezoning map change for Mapes Avenue site, Bronx
summary: This resolution approves a City Planning Commission decision to change the zoning map for a site near East 182nd Street and Mapes Avenue in the Crotona section of the Bronx, upzoning it from R7-1 to R8 with a new C2-4 commercial overlay. The change would allow new buildings of up to 16 stories, including a residential tower at 2136 Crotona Parkway and a mixed-use building with ground-floor community space. It is tied to a related text amendment creating a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area.
